Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.account

Interface AccountRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Account,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Account,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Account,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Account,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Account,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Account>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Account,UUID>
public interface AccountRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Account,UUID>
Interface for managing accounts in the system. Provides methods to retrieve accounts based on client ID, status, and account ID.

    • findMaxAccountSeq

      @Query("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(a.accountSeq), 0) FROM Account a WHERE a.clientId = :clientId") int findMaxAccountSeq(@Param("clientId") UUID clientId)
      Finds the highest account number in the client's 1, 2, ... sequence, across every status, so a closed or blocked account's number is never handed out again.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the unique identifier of the client
      Returns:
      the highest sequence number, or 0 if the client has no numbered accounts

    • findByAccountIdAndClientIdForUpdate

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("SELECT a FROM Account a WHERE a.accountId = :accountId AND a.clientId = :clientId") Optional<Account> findByAccountIdAndClientIdForUpdate(@Param("accountId") UUID accountId, @Param("clientId") UUID clientId)
      Locks an account owned by the specified client until the calling transaction ends. Call within a write transaction before reading cash or holdings for validation. Competing trades and withdrawals must acquire this same lock before validation.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account to lock
      clientId - the client who must own it
      Returns:
      the locked account, or empty if the client doesn't own one with that ID

    • markInactiveNotified

      @Modifying @Query("UPDATE Account a SET a.inactiveNotifiedAt = :notifiedAt WHERE a.accountId = :accountId AND a.inactiveSince IS NOT NULL") int markInactiveNotified(@Param("accountId") UUID accountId, @Param("notifiedAt") OffsetDateTime notifiedAt)
      Records that the client was emailed about the account's inactive period. Sets only this column, so it cannot overwrite a change made to the account since it was read, and does nothing if the account was reactivated in the meantime.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account
      notifiedAt - when the email was sent
      Returns:
      the number of accounts updated, 0 or 1

    • findEmptySince

      @Query("SELECT a.accountId AS accountId, COALESCE(MAX(c.createdAt), a.createdAt) AS emptySince\nFROM Account a LEFT JOIN CashLedgerEntry c ON c.accountId = a.accountId\nWHERE a.status = \'ACTIVE\'\n AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Position p WHERE p.accountId = a.accountId AND p.quantity <> 0)\n AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CashLedgerEntry b WHERE b.accountId = a.accountId\n GROUP BY b.currency HAVING SUM(b.amount) <> 0)\nGROUP BY a.accountId, a.createdAt\nHAVING COALESCE(MAX(c.createdAt), a.createdAt) < :cutoff") List<AccountRepository.EmptyAccount> findEmptySince(@Param("cutoff") OffsetDateTime cutoff)
      Finds active accounts with no cash in any currency and no shares that have been empty since before the cutoff. Cash only changes with a ledger entry, so an empty account has been empty since its last entry, or since it was opened if it has none.
      Parameters:
      cutoff - only accounts that became empty before this are returned
      Returns:
      the empty accounts, with when each became empty
